rationale: Coverage thresholds are met: 9/9 P0 oracle items are FULL, and all 23 tests pass against a live PostgreSQL container (13 unit, 10 e2e). ACF-GOV-01 is resolved: both AD-1 rounds now carry a named approver, date and recorded basis. The gate remains FAIL on the two blockers that are not about evidence. The HTTP allow/deny mapping is still an Access Control assumption pending answer 3 of the User Management integration contract, and the production module is dormant — AppModule does not import AccessControlModule, so GET /users/:id remains on the interim allow-all adapter while the suite reaches the real facade through a test-only provider override. Either condition independently prevents PASS; together they mean the story's evidence is genuine but demonstrates a component that is not in the request path.

ad1_round_1.basis: Suite README read, then each scenario's behaviour restated in plain language before approval. Per-file markers written under each **Trace:** line.

ad1_round_2.basis: Walkthrough of the fixture, the ten requests and what each asserts. Not a line read.

ACF-AU-05 denies the colleague outright while §3.3.4 entitles them to S1, S10 dates and the S11 project name
